theorems.name: Submission.dohr_eb_lhr_dqwe_shifted_weak_identity
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (U : Set (Rn n)) (a : Rn n → (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ) →L[ℝ] (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ) →L[ℝ] ℝ) (Φ : Rn n → (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ) →L[ℝ] ℝ) (v : Rn n → Rn ℓ) (h : Rn n) (η : Rn n → Rn ℓ), (∀ ζ : Rn n → Rn ℓ, ContDiff ℝ 1 ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ U → ∫ x in U, a x (fderiv ℝ v x) (fderiv ℝ ζ x) = ∫ x in U, Φ x (fderiv ℝ ζ x)) → ContDiff ℝ 1 η → HasCompactSupport η → (∀ x ∈ tsupport η, x + h ∈ U) → ∫ x, a (x + h) (fderiv ℝ v (x + h)) (fderiv ℝ η x) = ∫ x, Φ (x + h) (fderiv ℝ η x)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
